received_complete_common.warning: These are actual full-read source facts, not declarations of all transitive domain completion.

received_complete_facts.fact: Adapter gets strict item data; buys positive temporary buy override else data price; sell uses nonnegative sell override else data sell; canSell rejects important or price<=0. Resource setter delegates Player; add/remove are one at a time. Quantity windows begin1, cancel0; ordinary sell upper is held quantity; buying flag controls price shown. Item/machine names and display extras are independent from transaction price.

Stock list and description/icon presentation, scrolling and refresh retain supplied stock reference. Quantity input wraps +/-1 and changes10 with clamps; initial1 and cancel0. Confirm display uses full quantity*buyprice. Timed feedback waits1.5 seconds except USE; no rendered-pixel claim.

Normal Buy loop: first affordability guard, important quantity1 confirmation or ordinary maximum min(999,floor(money/price)) with free999, explicit qty0/refusal cancel, second affordability check. Add one by one; complete success updates spent money stat and item count then wallet, deletes important owned from aliased stock, messages, bonus. Failure removes just-added prefix one by one, removal failure raises; no purchase stat/wallet update on that branch.

Premier bonus after purchase commit: quantity>=10 and registered Premier data. Generous mode any PokeBall floor(qty/10), add until failure, actual bonus count increments stat; zero additions still displays zero result. Legacy only POKEBALL one successful extra. No rollback of purchase on bonus capacity failure.

Sell rejection checks important/price<=0 before quantity. Quantity begins1, explicit chosen5 differs default1. Commit old money→setter clamp→actual increase stat→unchecked per-item removals→feedback/refresh. Cancel/refusal before commit writes no sale state.

Entry normalizes each supplied stock element in place and deletes important already owned; menu references same array. canSell flag changes commands. Both ordinary exits clear entire temporary price table; errors/abnormal return have no guaranteed cleanup. No automatic stock reconstruction.

BP adapter positive temporary buy-slot override else BPPrice default1. Setter uses Player BP clamp; no sale. Quantity confirmation full price but number window computes @buying false/nil→floor(unitprice/2)*qty, not floor(product/2).

BP scene list uses full price; number window initializes1, cancel0, wraps +/-1, +/-10 clamps; quantity subtotal half-price because buying instance variable absent. Visual output remains host dependent.

Two affordability checks, important1 or normal min(999,floor(BP/price)), free999; complete add updates BP spend and common items count then BP setter→stockfilter→feedback; partial add removes prefix and can raise on removal failure. No sell/Premier branch.

Shared input stock mutated/filtered. Nil greeting emits default then ordinary welcome; supplied greeting emits once. Exit Buy loop farewell then clear overlays then entry farewell, two normal goodbye messages.

manual_receiver_meaning.meaning: These four records are optional Shadow backup bodies, absent from default discovered PBS inputs. All below require explicit inclusion/installation and successful registry/archive loading. No default shop stock or purchase event is inferred from the record.

For the no-applicable-override case, buy/sell/BP values are the four complete rows above. Normal and BP buy use only positive temporary buy-slot override; normal sell accepts nonnegative sell-slot override. The overlay writer and arbitrary externally supplied stock are outside this receipt.

Names/description flow through Item getters into received shop list and description interfaces; machine extras, icon resolution, localization and rendered pixels are independent. For BPPrice=1 without positive override, quantity subtotal shows floor(1/2)*quantity=0 while confirmation and real cost use full quantity*1.

All four are nonimportant. Without positive override, TIMEFLUTE normal money price0 reaches free-item ordinary maximum999 subject to bag/cancel/confirmation and later checks; other values yield min(999,floor(resource/price)). Completed item additions precede spend statistics and resource setter; add failure rolls back the just-added prefix and may raise if removal fails. No all-or-nothing guarantee across arbitrary exceptions.

Without a nonnegative sell override, the three scents are sell-price positive and TIMEFLUTE price0 is rejected before quantity choice. Reached sale updates clamped wallet and actual-increase statistic before unchecked one-at-a-time removal, so no generic transaction rollback guarantee is inferred.

Entry normalizes and filters the supplied stock array in place; ordinary exit clears the full temporary price overlay. Abnormal exit has no guaranteed cleanup. No stock reconstruction or shop-presence claim follows from PBS alone.
